versions.changelog:
v2.3: Simplify to basic plumbing

- Remove all LLM complexity
- Agent does all thinking
- Simple callbacks with history
- Clean, minimal skill

v2.2.2: Fix connection timeout issue

- Clear timeout when connection succeeds
- Prevents false timeout errors
- Bridge mode now connects properly

v2.2.1: Fix async ws.onmessage for bridge mode

- Makes ws.onmessage callback async
- Fixes await in bridge mode
- Bridge mode now works properly

v2.2: Add bridge mode for agent-driven conversations

- New bridgeMode option for agent-driven responses
- INCOMING/RESPOND stdin protocol
- OpenClaw agent uses native LLM to generate responses
- Skill acts as WebSocket bridge
- No pattern matching - real AI conversation

v2.1: Add LLM-powered conversation with smart rules

- New generateResponse() function for contextual AI responses
- Conversation state tracking (topics, recent responses, questions)
- Automatic deduplication to avoid repeating similar responses
- Similarity checking with Jaccard algorithm
- Retries up to 3 times for unique responses
- Full documentation with examples
- Resets state when joining new rooms

v2.0: Add conversation history, echo prevention, and rate limiting. Callbacks now receive history array for context-aware responses. Auto-filters own messages to prevent infinite loops. 1 second rate limit between messages.
Initial release: autonomous ephemeral agent chat rooms with auto-generated credentials. Join rooms, converse autonomously, messages vanish after 5 minutes. No CLI commands — just ask, connect, talk.
